title: StockSmart Customer Request Setting the Customer-Owned Fill-To Level of a Converted Bin
content:
**StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program — bins converted from consignment.** When Corbett withdraws a slow-moving consigned item from its bin at a par review so that the bin is converted to customer-owned replenishment, the customer's own written request for that bin sets the customer-owned fill-to level the StockSmart converted-bin fill-to schedule gives, and flags the bin critical where the customer asks for it.

The request is the customer's. On the bin history it stands as a par level entry that names no reorder point and sets the customer-owned fill-to level, together with the critical flag the customer chooses.

### Filing the request: `submit_critical_bin_request_f65e9169`

A customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to file its own written request. One call books a single par level entry on the program's bin history, effective today: the bin keeps its label, item, special-stock flag and the consigned flag passed in, takes the fill-to level passed in and the critical flag the customer chooses, and carries a reorder point of 0, because the request names no reorder point. The entry carries a request reference of the form VBR-NNNNNN.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `vmi_program_id` | the reference number of the customer's StockSmart program that holds the bin, from the StockSmart program lookup | identifier |
| `bin_label` | the bin label exactly as it appears on the bin's entries in the bin history | text, copied character for character |
| `sku` | the Corbett item number exactly as it appears on the bin's entries | text, copied character for character |
| `special_stock` | whether the bin's latest entry flags the item as non-catalog special stock | `true` or `false` |
| `consigned` | whether the bin's latest entry still shows the bin as consigned | `true`; `false` when it already shows the bin customer-owned |
| `critical_item` | whether the customer asks for the bin to be flagged critical | `true` or `false` |
| `max_qty` | the customer-owned fill-to level of the bin | whole number of units, 1 or more |

### Receipt

On success: `status` "recorded", `vmi_bin_id` (reference number of the par entry), `change_reference` (format VBR-NNNNNN), `bin_label`, `sku`, `critical_item` (true or false), `consigned` (true or false), `min_qty` (always 0 on this request), `max_qty` (whole units) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). No other outcome is defined.

### Basis questions

**Who decides whether the bin is flagged critical?** The customer; the flag is set where the customer asks for it.

**Does the request set a reorder point?** No. It names none; the entry carries a reorder point of 0.
